scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @event-manager/api openapi && pnpm --filter @event-manager/public-api openapi && openapi-typescript openapi/core.json -o src/core.d.ts && openapi-typescript openapi/public.json -o src/public.d.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/core.d.ts src/public.d.ts dist/
